PERIOD OF CONTRACT: 01 YEAR ESTIMATED COST: Rs 21,92,803.20/- A. Essential / Prequalification Criteria: [Agencies has to upload all supporting documents dul y self attested with seal along with the Tender for the following criteria failing which offe r is liable for rejection. After price bid evaluation, the L1 agency has to submit the original documents for verification if asked.] 1) Bidder is required to upload the supporting documents in compliance to following points i. Legal Status/Certificate of Incorporation ii. PAN and active GST Registration iii. Solvency: The solvency should be at least Rs. 8.35 Lakh. The solvency certifi cate shall be from a nationalized bank or scheduled bank and issued within a period of 12 months from the final date of submission of tender. The certifica te should be in the form that “It is certified that the firm / contractor / compa ny Partner / Individual are / is solvent upto Rs ____ /- (Solvency amount)”. Please upload valid solvency certificate during tender submission. iv. Experience: Experience of having successfully completed works during last s even years ending on previous day of last day of submission of tender should be either of the following: · Three similar completed works each costing not less than the amount equ al Rs 8.77 Lakh. OR · Two similar completed works each costing not less than the amount equal to Rs 10.96 lakh. OR · One similar completed work costing not less than the amount equal to

Rs 17.54 Lakh. Notes: a) The work shall be completed as a whole. Partial value / completion are not t o be considered. b)In case of experience certificate obtained from organizations other than Gov ernment, the same shall be supported with TDS certificate for confirmation p urpose. Work experience as sub-contractor is not acceptable. c) The meaning of “Similar Work” for the purpose of tender is defined below. Similar Work means: Providing vehicle / Transport service of any Category to any Govt. / Private firm. Along with the quotation, Vendor has to provide com pletion certificate of the work order mentioned against experience. d)Work experience completed under JV/ as a subcontract will not be considere d for evaluation of experience criteria. v. Letter of Under Taking: Bidder shall submit an undertaking regarding accept ance of Scope of Work, and terms and conditions in Tender Document. Non A cceptance shall disqualify the Bidder. 2) The copy of the authorization letter / Power of Attorney as the proof of authoriz ation for signing on behalf of the Bidder, which should be accompanied by a Bo ard Resolution (in case of Pvt. Ltd. or Limited companies) regarding the same. 3) Bank Details: Details of ECS viz. Name of Bank, IFSC, MICR No. Branch, Account No. cancelled cheque where payments are to be credited. The same shall be uploaded in the form of ECS Mandate form duly signed by the bank. (Format enclosed in Annex ure-II) B.AGENCIES WHO ARE REGISTERED WITH MSME SHALL NOTE THE FOLLOW ING: i) The Agencies registered with MSME as Micro & Small enterprises shall be exempted from the paym ent of EMD (Earnest Money Deposit) only as defined under “Public Procurement Policy for Micro & Small Enterprises, New Delhi vide Gazette Notification date: 26.06.2020. However, EMD is not applicable for this Tender. ii) Purchase preference to Micro and Small Enterprises (MSMEs): Purchase preference will be given to MSMEs as defined in Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises (MSMEs) Order, 2012 dated 23.03.2012 issued by Ministry. In respect of bid for Services, the bidder must b e the Service Provider of the offered Services. Relevant documentary evidence in this regard shal l be upload along with the bid in respect of the offered product or service. If L1 is not an MSE and MSE seller (s) has/have quoted price within L1 + 15% of margin of purchase preference / price ba nd defined in relevant policy, such seller shall be given opportunity to match L1 price and contra ct will be awarded for percentage of 100% of total value. iii) Submit UDYAM Registration Certificate. C.IMPORTANT NOTE: 1. The L1 will be decided on package basis. 2. The work is on Package basis. 3. This is a Two Bid system of tendering. Bidder should note that rate in any for m in should not be uploaded in technical bid. If Price bid submitted along wit h Technical Bid, Bid will be rejected during Technical Evaluation.
